definitions.explanation: question word used with the counter {枚|まい} to ask about the quantity of flat, thin objects such as paper, photos, clothes, plates, CDs, etc.

examples.japanese: シャツは{何枚|なんまい}ありますか。
{写真|しゃしん}を{何枚|なんまい}{撮|と}りましたか。
examples.english: How many photos did you take?

examples.japanese: ピザを{何枚|なんまい}{注文|ちゅうもん}しますか。
examples.english: How many pizzas shall we order?

notes:
COUNTER QUESTION:
{何枚|なんまい} combines {何|なん} (what/how many) with the counter {枚|まい} for flat objects.

OBJECTS COUNTED WITH {枚|まい}:
- {紙|かみ}/{書類|しょるい} - paper/documents
- {写真|しゃしん} - photos
- シャツ/Tシャツ - shirts/T-shirts
- {皿|さら} - plates
- CD/DVD - CDs/DVDs
- チケット - tickets
- ピザ - pizza
- {板|いた}/{板|ばん} - boards

RELATED COUNTER QUESTIONS:
- {何冊|なんさつ} - how many (books)
- {何杯|なんばい}/{何杯|なんぱい} - how many (cups)
- {何本|なんぼん} - how many (long objects)
- {何個|なんこ} - how many (small items)
